findings.failure_path: when codex exits non-zero with nothing on either stream the builder hits `if not text: sys.exit(0)`, leaving TRANSPORT_DIAGNOSTIC empty so emit_inconclusive drops the key and a transport-failure receipt carries no transport_diagnostic, contradicting the every-failure-receipt acceptance and making key presence indistinguishable from success
findings.smallest_fix: emit a fixed placeholder such as "no transport output captured" when both sources are empty so every failure receipt carries the key

findings.failure_path: the over-limit truncation keeps the first LIMIT-15 characters of the combined text, but the intent specifies falling back to the stderr tail, so with stderr longer than 600 characters the receipt preserves startup noise and loses the trailing lines that typically name the failure
findings.smallest_fix: when truncating keep the end of the stream instead, e.g. prepend a truncation marker and take text[-(LIMIT-15):]

concern_results.conclusion: Event-stream extraction (top-level error/*.failed only, message or error.message, deduped) and the extended quota/auth greps match the stated classification intent, and classifier order is unchanged; however the diagnostic builder exits with no output when both the event stream and stderr are empty, so not every transport-failure receipt carries transport_diagnostic as the acceptance requires.

The diagnostic is bounded, single-line, and redacted for home path, run-root path, URL query strings, and the enumerated credential shapes at the point it is built, and model-authored item events have no path into it; no redaction bypass was demonstrable from the bounded packet.

Unreadable or malformed event streams degrade softly to the stderr fallback and neither python step can abort the wrapper, but the fallback keeps the head of an over-long stream while the intent specifies the stderr tail, so a noisy log would drop the trailing lines that name the cause.

The new stub behaviors and rows cover quota-event, auth-event, nested-model-text refusal, redaction, truncation, query stripping, and success-receipt stability, with RED and mutation evidence claimed consistent with the rows; no row exercises a failure with both streams empty, which is where the diagnostic key silently disappears.

emit_inconclusive's new positional defaults to empty so existing call sites are byte-identical, no flag, exit code, reason code, or CANDIDATE_LOCAL_CODES change occurs, and the heredoc-in-command-substitution Bash 3.2 hazard is avoided by writing through files; no compatibility regression found.

The change is additive and local to one wrapper, persists no state, requires no schema or consumer change since review_gate.py relays unknown keys, and a revert restores prior behavior with nothing to unwind.

Failure receipts now carry a bounded redacted single-line diagnostic on every classified and terminal transport branch, closing the evidence-loss defect; the empty-stream failure case still produces a receipt with no diagnostic at all.

Restricting classifier input to top-level transport events contains the packet-steered-verdict bypass and the fixture proves nested item text cannot classify; the *.failed suffix match is broader than the two observed transport event types (error, turn.failed), though the packet shows no concrete event that carries model text at top level.
